source.title: DNA barcoding of the ichthyofauna of Taal Lake, Philippines
source.citation: Aquilino, S. V. L., Tango, J. M., Fontanilla, I. K. C., Pagulayan, R. C., Basiao, Z. U., Ong, P. S., & Quilang, J. P. (2011). DNA barcoding of the ichthyofauna of Taal Lake, Philippines. Molecular Ecology Resources, 11(4), 612-619. https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1755-0998.2011.03000.x

studyContext.abstractLocator: PubMed abstract; publisher full text was not acquired in this review.
studyContext.interpretation: The abstract's study totals are reported as published and are not treated as an independently checked specimen ledger or a complete/current Taal Lake inventory.

retrieval.method: NCBI E-utilities GenBank flat-file metadata retrieval over HTTPS; no API key used.
retrieval.snapshotTracking: Ignored local research snapshot; raw sequence/flat-file content is not included in this tracked review.

screeningEnvelope.purpose: Broad plausibility screen only; not an official lake boundary or geometry.

coordinateReview.decision: Do not map or expose any GenBank coordinate from this batch. Falling inside the broad screening envelope does not validate a collection point, while 88 coordinate fields conflict with the Taal locality text at this coarse screen. Preserve the NCBI locality text separately from coordinates.

crossLinkedAccessions.relationship: These records cite both the Taal barcoding article and a separate 2011 tawilis paper. Kept separate from the 113-record HQ654 batch; their inclusion in the article's 118-individual sample was not resolved here and they are not counted as an additional species or independent sample.

taxonomyReview.decision: Preserve the GenBank source spellings and use the separate crosswalk only for current-name reference. Apogon hyalosoma maps to Yarica hyalosoma in the checked Catalog of Fishes page. Oligolepis acutipennis has a family conflict between that catalog and GBIF Backbone Taxonomy. Neither nomenclature result validates specimen identity or admits an app assertion.

rightsReview.ncbiPolicySummary: NCBI states that it places no general restrictions on GenBank data use or distribution, but warns that submitters may claim intellectual-property rights in some or all submitted data and that NCBI cannot grant those rights.

publisherAccessReview.articlePageStatus: The publisher page was reviewed; it states the hosted full text is unavailable because of technical difficulties. No article-specific Creative Commons or other open license was displayed.
publisherAccessReview.termsSummary: Wiley's current terms reserve rights except for listed permissions and applicable open-access licenses; the page does not grant permission to republish article content in a public app.

rightsReview.publicationStatus: No article text, table, figure, image, or nucleotide sequence is reproduced in this review. The abstract and bibliographic record remain cited; access to the full article and specimen documentation is unresolved.
rightsReview.decision: Retain the source as a research lead. Do not publish an extracted species table or derived public-app batch from this article without an item-specific rights basis; do not infer unrestricted rights from GenBank availability.

decisions.historicalTextLocalityEvidence: research-lead-only; eligible for a separate taxonomic and field-level review

nextReview: Review specimen-level identity and article/database reuse eligibility before considering any historical text-locality assertion.
